items.name: Portfolio
items.statusNote: The live prototype already walks this.
items.summary: See use across the estate, a group, or a site.
items.who: A Customer uses Portfolio. Viewer can look. Contributor can work.

When other sites use the preset, the banner also names them, such as the times at Euston, Rugby, and 2 more sites.

stories.name: Follow an export in Downloads
stories.want: see where my export is up to on the Downloads tab
stories.benefit: I can keep working and come back when the file is ready
stories.notes: The time an export takes is not known, so the progress bar shows no percentage and no time left. It keeps moving until the backend says the file is ready or has failed. The backend sets when a file moves from Waiting to Processing, and its text. How long files stay in Downloads is still to be confirmed. The banner stays until Hide, as a banner that hides itself on a timer fails WCAG 2.2.1. In the prototype, a first try at a Source data export of more than 20,000 meter-days fails, so Failed and Try again can be seen.

estimate.help: Points are relative size, not days. Each story has two estimates. Find a site or meter is the 2 for both.

dev.help: Dev points size the work to build it. Complexity is how hard the logic is. Effort is how much there is to build. Risk is how likely it is to go wrong. Dependencies are what it needs from other teams or stories.

test.help: Test points size the work to check it. Scenarios are how many cases to run. Setup is the data and roles each case needs. Risk is how bad a missed bug would be. Regression is how much else needs a check again.
